Its datasheet (ENVIRO-SEAL packing system, Table 2) gives a maximum pressure/temperature limit of 104 bar (1500 psig) with ENVIRO-SEAL Graphite ULF packing, at up to 316 °C (600 °F); with ENVIRO-SEAL PTFE and Duplex packing the limit is full CL300 up to 232 °C / 450 °F. The other items on the path with datasheets (the CHV check valves, LV-54-1, and the pumps/exchangers/gate valves) have no maximum allowable pressure stated — CHV valves list only seat leak rates and LV-54-1 lists stem torque values — so no other pressure value can be compared.
